packageRules.description: Each @effect/tsgo release supports only the TypeScript versions its README lists, so bun run check:effect fails if typescript moves alone. Set typescript by hand to a version the new @effect/tsgo lists.

Temporary until TypeScript 7.1 is released. The 7.1 nightlies move daily and @effect/tsgo accepts only the nightlies it lists, so pin typescript by hand to one of those when an @effect/tsgo update lands.
agents peers on exact @modelcontextprotocol/client and /server versions. Bump both by hand to match when an agents release moves those pins.

vite-plus bundles an exact vitest and fails on a mismatched @vitest/* package. On each vite-plus update, set vitest (devDependencies and overrides) and every @vitest/* package to the version it bundles.
